topic: Redesign player and advisor panel split
currentUserGoal: Keep iterating the clean-break redesign while preserving the old game's graphical vibe, and fix the side HUD identity problem where Sensi appeared to be the player portrait/profile.
changesMade: Split the wide-layout side HUD into a player identity/status panel and a separate Sensi advisor panel.
Changed the top-left portrait panel to read as the player/Grass Toucher, showing phase/status, permanent Grass Touches, and owned memory.
Moved Sensi dialogue and mood color changes into the advisor panel below the player panel.
Stopped Sensi mood pulses from recoloring the player portrait frame; the player portrait now keeps a stable bronze pulse.
Moved the run feed lower in the side column so player identity, advisor dialogue, and feed each have their own surface.
Added player/advisor panel text and visibility fields to the prototype browser debug dataset for regression smoke checks.
Updated docs/CORE_MECHANICS_REDESIGN.md and docs/CORE_MECHANICS_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md with the new player/advisor split and browser smoke expectation.
verification: npm run check passed after the split: ESLint passed, Vitest passed with 2 files and 19 tests, TypeScript compiled, and Vite built successfully.

Browser smoke on http://127.0.0.1:5173/?redesign&resetMemory confirmed a clean load with one canvas, grass-app-ready true, activeObjectiveId wakeAncientGrass, activeRootCount 1, and introCardVisible true.

Fresh browser debug state confirmed playerPanelTitle Grass Toucher, playerPanelBody Player / Field heir with Permanent GT 0 and Memory: none, advisorPanelTitle Sensi // Advisor, and advisorPanelBody carrying the Sensi intro line.

Browser smoke clicked the reported first-root hitbox at 640,437 and confirmed introActive false, introCardVisible false, activeObjectiveId earnRunTouches, activeGridSize 2, activeRootCount 4, totalRunTouchesEarned 4, and runTouches 4.
After the first root click, browser debug state confirmed playerPanelTitle stayed Grass Toucher, playerPanelBody changed to Player / Manual caretaker, and Sensi dialogue stayed in Sensi // Advisor.
Browser visual check confirmed the top-left panel reads as the player, the separate advisor panel reads Sensi // Advisor, the run feed sits below both, and the field remains visible/readable.
Browser warn/error logs were empty during the player/advisor split smoke.
currentGitStatus: Branch codex/gameplay-update has modified tracked files: handoffs/LATEST.json, package-lock.json, package.json, src/game/scenes/GameScene.ts, and src/main.ts.

Intended redesign files remain untracked until the user asks to stage/commit: docs/CORE_MECHANICS_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, docs/CORE_MECHANICS_REDESIGN.md, eslint.config.js, vitest.config.ts, public/assets/ui/characters/, src/game/redesign/, src/game/scenes/RedesignPrototypeScene.ts, tests/, this handoff, and earlier redesign handoffs.

Pre-existing unrelated untracked docs/media remain untouched: docs/GAME_SYSTEMS_REFERENCE CLAUDE.md, Dutch automation reference docs, docs/artifacts/title-art-2026-06-19/, docs/back of the enveloppe.md, docs/grasstouching.mid, docs/lucid.aif, and handoffs/HANDOFF_2026-06-20_POST_PUSH_WORKFLOW_TEST.json.
knownIssues: The player portrait is still a placeholder Grass Toucher class icon, not a custom player avatar.
The Sensi advisor panel currently only appears as its own surface in the wide layout; compact/mobile layout still needs a deliberate presentation pass.
The advisor copy is still a lightweight rotating bark system, not a full authored dialogue system with portraits, steps, or choices.
The old game still exists on the default route and in obsolete systems; do not use ?stress as evidence of redesign progress.

If a player dies before healing the tutorial wound, they can still buy memory, but the objective chain remains at stabilizeWound. Decide later whether this is acceptable failure/retry behavior or needs a catch-up objective rule.
nextRecommendedSteps: Replace the player PFP placeholder with a proper new-canon player avatar while keeping Sensi exclusively as advisor/NPC.
Do a compact/mobile HUD pass so the player and Sensi identities remain separated on narrow screens.
Play through the normal-speed ?redesign route manually and judge first-run pacing without fastDormancy.
Start improving animation and juice on the 1x1 to 2x2 opening beat now that the identity surface is readable.
After the first-run feel is readable, choose the first recast in-run tool or automation instead of porting old systems wholesale.
doNotRevert: Do not put Sensi back into the player profile/PFP panel.
Do not make Sensi mood color changes recolor the player portrait frame.
Do not remove the player/advisor browser debug fields without replacing the smoke coverage for this identity split.
Do not make the intro callout itself start the run; only real root tile clicks should wake the run.
Do not return redesign manual healing to broad canvas/proximity clicks.
Do not commit unrelated local docs or media unless the user specifically asks.
